name: TREEWIDTH2_LIST_COLORING_POLYNOMIAL_TERMINAL

external_authority.reference: Klaus Jansen and Petra Scheffler, Generalized coloring for tree-like graphs, Discrete Applied Mathematics 75(2):135-155 (1997)
external_authority.result: List Coloring on partial k-trees is linear-time for a fixed number of colors.

external_authority.reference: Wald and Colbourn characterization, as standardly cited in treewidth literature
external_authority.result: A graph has treewidth at most 2 iff it is a partial 2-tree iff it has no K4 minor.

terminal_definition.input: A graph C with exact lists L(v) subseteq [4] and a verified tree decomposition of width at most 2.
terminal_definition.dp_state: For each bag, record exactly those proper color assignments to bag vertices that respect their current lists and extend to the processed part of the decomposition.
transitions: Introduce vertex: extend predecessor states with an allowed color for the introduced vertex and enforce all already-present bag edges.
Forget vertex: project predecessor states to the remaining bag.
Join: intersect compatible child-state tables on the common bag.
Accept iff the root table is nonempty.
Store predecessor witnesses for polynomial reconstruction of a full list-coloring.

recognition_and_certification.positive_certificate: A tree decomposition whose every bag has size at most 3; verifier checks vertex coverage, edge coverage, and running-intersection property.
recognition_and_certification.negative_certificate: A K4-minor model consisting of four pairwise-disjoint connected branch sets with an inter-branch edge for every unordered pair.

target_claims: With palette [4] fixed, arbitrary-list coloring on graphs of treewidth at most 2 is polynomial-time solvable; with a width-2 decomposition the DP has at most 4^3=64 raw color assignments per bag.
A width-2 decomposition is a proof-carrying positive terminal certificate.
A K4-minor model is an independently checkable certificate that treewidth is greater than 2.
The terminal does not require P7-freeness for its internal correctness.
Exact boundary restrictions must already be encoded in the lists before invoking the terminal.
forbidden: Infer anything about K4-minor-containing residuals beyond non-applicability of the tw<=2 terminal.
Use absence of a decomposition found by a heuristic as a negative certificate.
Modify C11 state, Pi semantics, or start a repair.
